result.evidence_quote: the major goal of this study was to examine the impact of common comorbidities on the clinical outcomes of COVID-19 patients in Sétif, Algeria, as well as to evaluate the local epidemiological risk profile.
result.rationale: The study examines COVID-19 severity and mortality associated with diabetes, cardiovascular disease, and hypertension. The abstract does not address neural mechanisms, cognition, neurological disease, neural injury, or neurological treatments or biomarkers.
